vo.speaker: command
vo.text: Hammer Two-Six, Anvil Actual. Two thousand men are dug in around that castle, and you are the only aircraft I have. Break the field army. Silence the walls. Then kill the warlord. You have until sundown.

vo.speaker: command
vo.text: Two-Six, you are cleared hot. Use the approach to get a feel for her. Collective climbs. It does not push you forward.

vo.speaker: command
vo.text: Nose down to build speed. Level off to hold it.

vo.speaker: command
vo.text: Check your gunner sight. And remember: while you are aiming the cannon, nobody is flying the aircraft.

vo.speaker: command
vo.text: Flare back to bleed your speed. The army is just over that ridge.

vo.speaker: command
vo.text: There they are. Two thousand strong. Go to work, Two-Six.
vo.event: setPhase(1) on first run, with mus_reveal

vo.speaker: command
vo.text: Phase one. Break the field army. Kill the banner guard, and the block will run.

vo.speaker: command
vo.text: Formation routed. Keep the pressure on.

vo.speaker: command
vo.text: One more formation, Two-Six. Finish them.

vo.speaker: command
vo.text: The low pass is working. Their shield wall is broken. Hit them now.

vo.speaker: command
vo.text: They are terrified of you. Use it.

vo.speaker: command
vo.text: Field army is broken. Phase two: silence the walls. Four gate towers. Be advised, bombards and trebuchets are now in play.

vo.speaker: command
vo.text: They've brought out pavise shields. Their archers are covered now.

vo.speaker: command
vo.text: Last tower, Two-Six. Bring it down.

vo.speaker: command
vo.text: One less thing shooting at you.

vo.speaker: command
vo.text: The walls are silent. Phase three. The warlord is in the courtyard with his guard. Fire pots are lit. Your rotor wash will clear the smoke. Finish this.

vo.speaker: command
vo.text: Heads up. They've re-laid the bombards to your altitude. Change it.

vo.speaker: command
vo.text: You're losing the light, Two-Six. The sun is almost gone.

vo.speaker: command
vo.text: It's dark. You're fighting by firelight now.

vo.speaker: command
vo.text: The warlord is down. I say again, the warlord is down. The siege is broken. Outstanding work, Two-Six. Come home.

vo.speaker: command
vo.text: Two-Six is down. I say again, Two-Six is down. Damn it.

vo.speaker: command
vo.text: Two-Six, you have left the combat area. Mission abort.
vo.event: mission.lose() cause: left the combat area

vo.speaker: command
vo.text: Two-Six, you are drifting to the edge of the combat area.

vo.speaker: command
vo.text: Return to the combat area. Now.

vo.speaker: command
vo.text: You're running dry. The rearm pad is on the far hill.

vo.speaker: command
vo.text: On the pad. Rearming and repairing. Make it quick.

vo.speaker: command
vo.text: You're loaded. Get back in the fight.
vo.event: takeoff from pad with full ammo

vo.speaker: command
vo.text: Two-Six, you are trailing smoke. Your call. Push on, or limp home.

vo.speaker: pilot
vo.text: That... is a lot of spears.

vo.speaker: pilot
vo.event: first rocket of a salvo (rate-limit 10 s)

vo.speaker: pilot
vo.text: Tail rotor's hit. She's pulling on me.

vo.speaker: pilot
vo.text: Hydraulics are going. Controls are sluggish.

vo.speaker: pilot
vo.text: Canopy's cracked. I can barely see.

vo.speaker: pilot
vo.text: I'm Winchester. Heading for the pad.

vo.speaker: pilot
vo.event: big kill count in one pass

vo.speaker: pilot
vo.text: Mayday, mayday! Two-Six is going down!

vo.speaker: pilot
vo.text: I can't hold her! I can't hold her!

vo.speaker: gunner
vo.event: boulder within 4 s of impact near heli

vo.speaker: gunner
vo.text: Banner guard, centre of the block.

vo.speaker: gunner
vo.text: I can't see through this smoke. Get lower and wash it out.

vo.speaker: gunner
vo.text: That's him. Gold banner, centre of the courtyard.

vo.speaker: captain
vo.event: formation under fire, not yet routed

vo.speaker: serjeant
vo.text: Stand fast, you dogs! Stand fast!

vo.speaker: captain
vo.text: Fall back! Fall back to the castle!

vo.speaker: warlord
vo.text: Light the fire pots! Blind the beast!

vo.speaker: warlord
vo.text: Come down and face me, demon!

vo.speaker: warlord
vo.text: It bleeds like any beast! Bring it down!

vo.speaker: warlord
vo.text: I will mount your iron wings above my gate!

vo.speaker: captain
vo.text: The beast is dead! The beast is dead!
